name: Maze
description:
Connect Maze to look up research studies, review session results, and surface user insights without leaving the workflow. Find studies by topic even when the study name is unknown, go through participant responses and task metrics, retrieve highlights and themes from moderated and unmoderated sessions, and pull recordings or transcripts for deeper analysis.

Useful for pulling evidence for a product decision, synthesizing research before a design review, or catching up on studies that have not been reviewed yet.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Maze to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Maze to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.maze.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Maze MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maze provides these MCP tools: get_ai_moderated_session, get_ai_moderated_study, get_moderated_session, get_moderated_study, get_resource, get_unmoderated_study, get_user_details, search, and submit_mcp_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Maze?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Maze in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Maze requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Maze is developed by Maze. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
